Mohammed Razack U.K vs Food Safety Officer Sulthan Bathery 
... on 19 March, 2024 
Author: Bechu Kurian Thomas Bench: Bechu Kurian Thomas Crl . MC No.962/2023 1/1  IN THE HIGH COURT OF KERALA AT ERNAKULAM  PRESENT  THE HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE BECHU KURIAN THOMAS  Tuesday, the 19th day of March 2024 / 29th Phalguna, 1945  CRL.M.APPL.NO.1/2023 IN CRL.MC NO. 962 OF 2023  CC 702/2021 OF JUDICIAL FIRST CLASS MAGISTRATE COURT, SULTHANBATHERY, WAYANAD  APPLICANTS/PETITIONERS/ACCUSED NOS.1 & 2:
 1. MOHAMMED RAZACK U.K. S/O HUSSAN PARAKKAL HOUSE, PANTHERANKAVU  P.O. KOZHIKODE  (FOOD BUSINESS OPERATOR AND NOMINEE OF FIRM WHO SOLD UNSAFE  CHILLI POWDER TO THE FOOD SAFETY OFFICER), PIN - 673019  AND ANOTHER  RESPONDENTS/COMPLAINANT,STATE & ANOTHER:
 1. FOOD SAFETY OFFICER SULTHAN BATHERY CIRCLE OFFICE OF THE FOOD  SAFETY OFFICER,
 WAYANAD  PIN - 673592  AND 2 OTHERS  Application praying that in the circumstances stated therein the High  Court be pleased to stay all further proceedings in C.C.702/2021  pending on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court - I,
 Sultan Bathery, pending disposal of the above Criminal Miscellaneous  Case. 
 This Application again coming on for orders upon perusing the  application and this court's order dated 21/09/2023 and upon hearing  the arguments of Mr. PREMJIT NAGENDRAN, Advocates for the petitioners  and the Public Prosecutor for the respondents 1&2, the court passed the  following:
